note: Best learned arm is the lowest out-of-fold Brier among learned arms in that split. Gaps are question-bootstrap 95% intervals; negative means the first predictor is better. Subject-out: model x subject falls back to the model rate. Model-out: model mean falls back to the training prior and model x subject to the subject rate. Holding out only the model (no question split) gave prompt-only Brier 0.130, because the other two models' answers to the same question were in training; that number is leakage and is not reported.
